{"consolidated_memory":"## Request timeout issues in services/auth/session_store.py — Two separate incidents

### Incident 1: 2026-04-25 — Race condition in lazy initialization

**File and component:** services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)

**Trigger:** Occurred only after rolling restart of the fleet

**Signal:** 30 second deadline in gateway log

**Root cause:** Race condition in lazy initialisation

**Fix:** Double-checked lock guarding the init (PR #5195, branch fix/request-timeout-1)

**Repro:** POST /login twice against warm cache

**Result:** Error rate dropped from 9.6% to under 3 per ten thousand

---

### Incident 2: 2026-07-10 — Missing composite database index

**File and component:** services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)

**Trigger:** Occurred only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary

**Signal:** 30 second deadline in gateway log

**Root cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)

**Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #7296, branch fix/request-timeout-2)

**Repro:** POST /login twice against warm cache

**Result:** Backlog cleared 50 minutes after deploy

**Tech stack:** Python

**Test coverage:** tests/auth/test_session_store.py

---

**Note:** Both incidents produced the same symptom (30-second deadline timeouts with identical repro) in the same file, but stemmed from completely different root causes. The April 25 incident was concurrency-related; the July 10 incident was data access performance-related."}
